dedupe_keys.name: hybrid dynamic model of a nuscale type small modular reactor with coupled rankine cycle for load following control rad jacob poudel mamtimin and zhang arxiv 2026

description: This record describes a hybrid dynamic modelling framework for a small modular reactor of NuScale type, presented in an arXiv preprint submitted on 17 June 2026 and revised on 25 July 2026. An equation-based model of the integral pressurised water reactor, primary loop and moving-boundary helical-coil once-through steam generator is coupled to a physics-based secondary Rankine cycle with steam throttle valve, turbine, condenser and feedwater pump, enforcing mass and energy conservation across the loops. The model reproduces design-point conditions and is used to study a 5% step reduction in turbine power demand under five control configurations; acting on valve, feedwater pump and control rods together gave the most balanced response, and coupling the cycle changed the predicted back-pressure and steam flow compared with a conventional linear model. Access: the preprint is free to read on arXiv; the page did not show code or a data link; the paper carries the arXiv non-exclusive distribution licence. Coverage is a single reactor design. Caveats: only the abstract page was read, no implementation is offered, and results concern simulated transients. It suits capacity planning and network flow studies of flexible nuclear operation with variable renewables, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
